pages.summary: A fortified desert settlement registered by the pinned Tensura build, with its own random-spread placement set.
details: The packaged structure targets the optional common desert tag and Minecraft's desert-village biome tag.
Spacing and separation describe the structure-set placement grid, not a guaranteed distance from spawn or a live-server discovery rate.

pages.summary: Five equally weighted travel-pad ruins registered for plains, cold, desert, badlands, and swamp terrain.
pages.biomes: Plains, forests, cold, desert, badlands, swamps
details: The structure set contains five variants with equal weight: plains, cold, desert, mesa, and swamp warp pads.
The biome tags also include Tensura's Desert of Death, Barren Land, and Miasmic Plains where appropriate.

pages.summary: Mysticism's registered large dark portal structure for biomes tagged with the dark element.
details: This is the large dark-portal structure that has both a structure definition and a structure set in Mysticism 2.1.2.
The matching biome tag is `mysticism:is_dark_biome`; the structure uses terrain adaptation that buries part of the template.

pages.summary: Mysticism's registered earth portal structure for biomes tagged with the earth element.
details: The earth portal has a complete structure definition, placement set, and biome tag in the pinned 1.21.1 artifact.
Its terrain adaptation buries part of the template so it can settle into the surrounding terrain.

pages.summary: Mysticism's registered wind portal structure for biomes tagged with the wind element.
details: The wind portal is one of the three elemental portals with a complete generation registration in Mysticism 2.1.2.
Fire, space, and water portal templates exist in the artifact, but they have no matching worldgen structure definitions or structure sets and are therefore not listed as generated structures.

pages.summary: A large Boss Structure landmark registered for deserts and the three vanilla badlands biomes.
pages.biomes: Desert, badlands, eroded badlands, wooded badlands
details: The pinned add-on registers Eurazania as a surface structure with beard-thin terrain adaptation.
Its biome tag is deliberately arid: desert plus normal, eroded, and wooded badlands.

pages.summary: A fortified church landmark registered across temperate plains, forests, taiga, and meadow terrain.
details: Hinata Church is registered as a surface structure with beard-thin terrain adaptation.
Its exact biome list includes plains, sunflower plains, several forests, taiga, and meadow.

pages.summary: A moonlit manor landmark registered across broad temperate, savanna, and windswept terrain.
pages.biomes: Plains, forests, taiga, meadow, savanna, windswept hills
details: Night Rose uses the add-on's broadest temperate placement list, including old-growth taiga, savanna, and windswept biomes.
The structure is registered as a surface landmark with beard-thin terrain adaptation.

pages.summary: A desert temple landmark registered by the pinned Tensura Boss Structure add-on.
details: The temple's packaged biome tag contains only the vanilla desert biome.
It is a surface structure with beard-thin terrain adaptation; this page does not infer boss triggers or loot that are not declared in the worldgen data.

pages.summary: A forest arena landmark registered across plains, forests, taiga, meadow, cherry, and light-jungle terrain.
pages.biomes: Plains, forests, taiga, meadow, cherry grove, bamboo jungle
details: The packaged placement list spans plains and temperate forests, all major taiga variants, meadow, cherry grove, bamboo jungle, and sparse jungle.
The page name follows the registry entry; encounter behavior is not inferred from the name alone.

pages.summary: A school landmark registered for plains and forest terrain in the pinned Boss Structure build.
details: The display name is normalized for readers; the packaged registry ID is spelled `shizhu_school`.
Its biome tag covers plains, sunflower plains, and the principal vanilla forest variants.
